messages:
maria: Nightly eval alert for redwood/open-ql-v2-q8 — a bunch of function_call outputs failing JSON parse in the tool harness. Dumping two representative snippets below. Can people triage?

maria: BAD EX #1:
```
"function_call": {"name":"create_ticket","arguments":"{'summary':'Generate report for Q1','assignee':'ops','priority':'high', }"}
```

maria: BAD EX #2 (truncated / streaming):
```
"function_call": {"name":"update_status","arguments":"{\"id\":12345, \"status\":\"done\""
```

aj: ugh single quotes + stringified JSON + trailing comma. Looks like model is emitting arguments as a string instead of an object. Which model variant + quant config?

maria: model: redwood/open-ql-v2 (quant q8h-modded), nightly-run: 2026-03-19T03:12Z, commit: 9f4b1e2. Quant config: per-channel q8, kernel-set=fast-attn, batch-scheduler=continuous. Prompt set id: eval-promptset-2026-03-16.

liam: :eyes: streaming truncation seems likely for the second example. When streaming with continuous batching small chunks can cut JSON mid-object. We saw similar with q4 streaming patch last year.

danielle: Could also be tokenization differences after quantization — some kernels produce different token splits (escape chars). But single quotes and trailing commas look like model-level formatting choice. Are these from the same prompt that instructs a JSON function_call?

maria: yes prompt explicitly: call function create_ticket with JSON args (schema enforced). Nightly harness asserts JSON.parse(args) and fails. Failing count: 42/1200 tests on that run. Attached are 20 raw samples (pasted into the run artifact).

aj: quick triage checklist: 1) reproduce locally with same quant binary and batch scheduler 2) check streaming vs final non-streaming output 3) inspect tokenizer diffs 4) try temperature=0 decode to see if greedy fixes it 5) compare to float32 baseline output. I'll start 1 and 2.

liam: I can repro streaming truncation locally when batch window < 30ms. Running a local worker now with batch-window=100ms to compare.

danielle: For mitigation we should add a conservative pre-parse scrub in the tool-caller: try JSON.parse(args) -> if fails try heuristics: replace single quotes with double quotes, strip trailing commas, attempt to find the first/last braces and parse substring, and as fallback run ast.literal_eval-like recovery. But we must log original payload and increment metric for "repaired_fncall_args".

aj: agree on adding a repair heuristic but we should be explicit: heuristics only in hosted tool-caller and only as a last resort with audit logging AND rate-limited to avoid hiding model regressions. Also add a toggle in console to disable auto-repair per-customer.

maria: good. Also want an eval test to detect this pattern earlier: nightly-eval should assert that function_call.arguments is a JSON object type, not string, and also run a small regex to detect single-quote-only objects. If threshold > X% fail, fail the model bring-up.

nightly-ci: nightly run 2063056789 artifact: https://ci.redwood/redwood/nightly/2063056789 (contains raw outputs + repro scripts).

infra-bot: repro job queued: job/ci-repro/2063056789 (link: https://ci.redwood/job/ci-repro/2063056789)

aj: initial repro notes: non-streaming decode returns a well-formed object in float32 baseline, q8 returns stringified-args in ~30% of cases, streaming cuts off JSON in ~10% additional cases. Looks like two failure modes: model formatting and stream chunking.

liam: kernel patch hypothesis: fast-attn q8 kernel emits slightly different logits due to fused kernels which can change punctuation tokens. Those punctuation shifts could flip a double-quote to single-quote tokenization in rare cases.

danielle: action items: @aj open PR for repair heuristics + metrics (STAGE: hosted only). @danielle add nightly-eval assertion and alerting (fail the bring-up job). @maria gather the 20 examples into a tracking issue and add to model-onboard board. @liam try kernel fallback (use stable-attn) and test impact.

maria: I'll open the issue and assign the samples now. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

aj: temporary prod mitigation: pin production routing to float32 or q4 variants until we have repair + regression gate. I'll send a routing patch. :lock:

liam: if anyone needs my repro environment: docker image redwood/dev-quant:2026-03-19 and the repro script is at artifacts/repro/run_repro.sh in the nightly artifact.

danielle: will add unit tests to eval harness to catch single-quoted args and trailing-comma patterns. Also add a fuzz test for streaming boundary conditions.

maria: thanks team. Logging follow-ups in the issue. :memo:
